verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a self-serve Dashboard seller path: choose to onboard as a seller, review an agent's terms, send an approval request, and publish a CSV catalog feed via the Product Catalog Import API. Separately, merchants can publish a machine-payments endpoint that returns HTTP 402, verify it with `mppx validate`, and settle to their Stripe balance. Each agent must still accept the seller's request, and parts of ACS carry private-preview, waitlist, application and geography gates. Missing for 10: fully ungated availability (ACS private preview, custom-endpoint waitlist, ChatGPT application, US/CA/EU-only), seller go-live not dependent on per-agent acceptance, independent hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow.
